{{Top}}
A '''superfluid''' was a state of matter supercooled beyond its freezing point to near [[absolute zero]], producing strange effects on the quantum level. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] artist [[Gorgo]] used a supercooled quantum condensate of [[prothium]] gas to produce [[decelerated luminescent image]]s of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
